verdict.rationale: NVIDIA documents CUDA Toolkit support for developing/deploying GPU-accelerated applications and community evidence (HN inference benchmark) shows PyTorch-based LLM workloads (Llama 405B) running in production on H200 SXM, implying framework compatibility via CUDA. However, there is no direct citation of an official PyTorch/TensorFlow support matrix or explicit framework-version compatibility documentation for H200 specifically. Missing for 10: explicit PyTorch/TensorFlow official support matrix naming H200, CUDA/cuDNN version compatibility table, first-party framework installation guide referencing H200.
